channel.title: Ente development digest
channel.description: AI-generated daily digest of PRs opened and merged in the Ente monorepo

item.title: Ente digest Aug 04, 2026 - 46 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos improvements across sharing, downloads, account switching, and mobile usability. The next wave includes richer album metadata, faster ML indexing status, and better preservation of edited-photo metadata.

Shipped

  • Photos web and server: Public and authenticated file, thumbnail, collection, memory, cast, and file-link downloads now use v3 URL endpoints, with compatibility fallbacks where needed: web public downloads, web authenticated downloads, public file URLs, and file URLs.
  • Mobile Photos: Library sharing is enabled using bulk sharing APIs (#11892), and Trash can now be used to free up space (#11878). Logout now clears account-specific caches, preventing data from one account appearing in another (#11787).
  • Unconfigured Albums, People, and Memories widgets now open their setup screens directly (#11770). The Memories banner is fully tappable (#11748), Android shows a deletion prompt when required permissions are unsupported (#11756), and Traditional Chinese is enabled (#11884).
  • Mobile Photos also improved password re-entry error handling (#11879) and made video-editor icons easier to see (#11848).
  • Web Albums: Upload progress and album uploads now use the newer components, with the obsolete v1 flow removed (progress, uploads, cleanup). Link previews and loading states were also improved (#11885, #11891).
  • Other shipped work includes restored previous mobile in-app-purchase behavior (#11888) and routine dependency, build, and code cleanup.

In progress

  • Album descriptions: Mobile Photos is adding editable descriptions alongside album names and cover photos (#11920).
  • ML indexing: An event-driven status service would replace repeated database polling and keep progress indicators and ML settings synchronized (#11918).
  • Edited photos are being updated to preserve supported EXIF metadata and enable lossless JPEG rotate/flip edits for everyone (#11889).
  • Additional mobile work covers dismissing the Memories crafting banner (#11917) and resolving the logged-in user’s avatar correctly (#11914).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 03, 2026 - 19 shipped, 8 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped several Photos usability improvements across mobile and widgets, alongside server-side sharing and account updates. In progress, the most user-visible work is a new mobile Trash view and broader access to video metadata.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Improved handling of password re-entry errors, making failed unlock or authentication attempts clearer and more reliable (#11879).
  • Photos widgets: Tapping an unconfigured Albums, People, or Memories widget now opens its matching customization screen directly on Android and iOS, instead of sending users to the app’s home screen (#11770).
  • Photos mobile: Video editor controls now use appropriately sized icons, improving their visibility in the bottom toolbar (#11848).
  • Photos mobile: Contact saves no longer accidentally remove an avatar while an avatar unlink is in progress (#11868).
  • Server: Added bounded bulk share and unshare operations for a collection and one recipient, including idempotent automatic sharing and Viewer-only uncategorized sharing (#11809).
  • Accounts and purchases: App Store sandbox purchases now also work for @ente.com accounts (#11872).
  • Other shipped maintenance included removing the legacy web upload flow, updating upload documentation, and improving Linux desktop publishing (#11858, #11860, #11870).

In progress

  • Photos mobile: A new Trash feature would let users manage deleted items and free up storage space (#11878).
  • Photos mobile: Video metadata in file details is being opened to all users, rather than only internal accounts (#11873).
  • Memories: The crafting-memories banner is receiving a visual redesign and a dismiss button (#11864, #11869).
  • Upcoming platform work includes recognizing @ente.com as an internal account and upgrading custom ONNX Runtime builds to 1.28 across clients (#11881, #11874).

item.title: Ente digest Aug 02, 2026 - 2 shipped, 0 in progress
item.description:
A quiet day in the Ente monorepo, with two changes shipped and no new work opened. The main user-facing update improves QR handling in the mobile photo viewer; shared icon coverage also expanded.

Shipped

  • Mobile Photos: QR detection now waits for the full image to render, reducing premature scans. Detection results are also tied to the source photo so QR regions cannot leak between adjacent images.
  • Icons: VGen and Palform icons were added for use wherever these services are represented in the product.

In progress

No new pull requests were opened in the last 24 hours.

item.title: Ente digest Aug 01, 2026 - 21 shipped, 3 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a strong set of Photos improvements across mobile, web, and desktop, including a faster panorama experience, more relevant face suggestions, and better handling of storage-related backup failures. Work in progress includes bulk collection sharing on the server and fixes for a device-space cleanup crash.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: A new in-tree panorama viewer improves first-open performance, keeps thumbnails visible while rendering, supports crop-aware zoom and motion viewing, and avoids camera jumps on mobile. Face suggestions now filter out low-quality or repeatedly rejected matches, making recommendations more relevant (#11817), and pinned people are visibly marked in search (#11810).
  • Backups now detect when the device is out of storage, stop pending uploads safely, and show an actionable error instead of repeatedly retrying and consuming more space (#11554). Own-collection timestamps also survive synchronization replay (#11752).
  • Photos web and desktop: Legacy recovery-sheet decoding is now bounded according to image orientation (#11820), and the web collection-map dialog no longer unnecessarily re-renders after a remote pull (#11804). Desktop also fixes the initial height of the All People modal (#11815).
  • Photos desktop: Native bindings now target Node-API 10 for Electron 42, improving compatibility with the bundled runtime (#11814). Corrupt ML models no longer trigger futile download retries; indexing is suspended instead (#11806).
  • Other: Desktop Space users can copy profile links (#11816), and mobile in-app purchases were updated for Google Play Billing 8 while retaining iOS receipt compatibility (#11730).

In progress

  • Upcoming sharing capability: The server is adding bounded bulk share and unshare endpoints for a single recipient, including idempotent automatic sharing and viewer-only uncategorized sharing (#11809).
  • Free Up Space is being hardened against Android bulk-deletion failures that could trigger hundreds of individual deletion calls and crash the app (#11802).
  • Shared legacy layout and autofocus components are being migrated into Ente Components, with no intended visual changes (#11812).

item.title: Ente digest Jul 31, 2026 - 23 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
A busy day for Ente Photos and Space: desktop ML infrastructure and panorama handling improved, while Space shipped web push and Firefox Android fixes. Several mobile reliability and account-isolation improvements also landed, with further Photos cleanup work in progress.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos desktop: Desktop ML indexing and CLIP text embedding now use the shared Rust ONNX Runtime implementation, with packaged native components for macOS, Windows, and Linux (#11746). Desktop model storage now also uses AssetStore (#11798), and missing code-generation dependencies produce clearer recovery instructions (#11799). A loading screen now appears while desktop files are parsed for confirmation (#11797).
  • Ente Photos mobile: Cropped panoramas now open centered and without a blank or blurred initial view (#11790, #11553). Uploading one photo to multiple albums now preserves every album upload (#11055), and camera permission failures offer clearer recovery paths, including Settings (#11779).
  • Photos purchases and media: In-app purchases were updated for Google Play Billing 8 while retaining legacy iOS receipt handling (#11730). Media picking now handles SD cards and other uncommon file paths more reliably (#11084).
  • Ente Space: Web push notifications are now available for Space activity and public profiles, alongside PWA setup prompts (#11773). Firefox Android notification delivery and related web behavior were fixed (#11791, #11793).
  • Mobile shared UI: Developer settings moved into Accounts and received a refreshed interface (#11784). Linked people can now have missing contacts created automatically when relevant pages open (#11775).

In progress

  • Photos web: Fixes are underway for collection-map re-rendering during remote pulls (#11804) and download progress toasts not appearing (#11803).
  • Photos mobile: A bounded recovery flow is being added to prevent Free Up Space crashes on affected Samsung devices (#11802). New Ente and device trash pages, plus native trash integration, are also in progress (#11785, #11781).
  • Account cleanup: Logout is being updated to clear cached social and favorites data, preventing information from a previous account appearing after switching users (#11787).

item.title: Ente digest Jul 30, 2026 - 14 shipped, 9 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of mobile usability and reliability improvements, alongside new Photos web referral settings and several UI refreshes. Work in progress focuses on smoother media deletion, widget setup, contacts, and Space notifications.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Media picked from SD cards and other uncommon storage locations is now copied to a temporary location before being shared with third-party apps, improving uploads on devices such as Samsung phones. PR #11084
  • Photos mobile: Camera permission recovery now distinguishes denied, restricted, settings-required, and retryable states, with clearer recovery actions. PR #11779
  • Photos mobile: Added native support for accessing the system trash, and stopped reporting expected upload-lock contention as errors. PR #11761 PR #11777
  • Photos web: Added Referral Settings. Memories also received UI and metadata-image updates, while previously added memory-link branding was reverted. PR #11758 PR #11768 PR #11766 PR #11767
  • Auth and Locker: Auth HTML exports now print with a corrected layout. Locker’s legacy PDF design was refreshed, with recovery information kept visible while hidden recovery metadata was removed. PR #11774 PR #11536
  • Mobile UI: Photos title bars and gradient buttons were migrated to the current component system, including a refreshed “Free up device space” screen. Locker’s link-picker UI received the same component migration. PR #11759 PR #11757 PR #11769

In progress

  • Photos mobile: A group of changes is adding system-trash file tracking, deletion prompts for unsupported Android media-management permissions, and file sizes to the trash database. PR #11781 PR #11762 PR #11756 PR #11754
  • Unconfigured Albums, People, and Memories widgets will deep-link directly to their setup screens on Android and iOS. PR #11770
  • Space is adding web push notifications for activity and public profiles, plus PWA setup prompts and feed/messaging refinements. PR #11773
  • Other upcoming improvements include moving developer settings under Accounts, auto-creating contacts for linked people, and preserving own-collect timestamps during sync reconciliation. PR #11784 PR #11775 PR #11752

item.title: Ente digest Jul 29, 2026 - 25 shipped, 6 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos usability improvements across mobile and web, including quieter sharing notifications, better video playback controls, and smoother sharing and import flows. Auth, Space, desktop ML, and platform reliability also received notable updates, while several Photos improvements are now in progress.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Shared-album notifications are now grouped by sender, preventing large shares from flooding recipients. Persistent video mute remembers the preference across restarts and prevents audio briefly playing before muted playback begins.
  • Photos sharing: Family users can share owned albums, update sharing roles, and stop sharing. Library-sharing UX was refined, including long-press album selection and clearer roles and defaults.
  • Photos reliability: Ritual camera startup now handles permissions cleanly and avoids indefinite loading. Invalid asset dates fall back to other available dates instead of aborting imports, and Memory Lane links filter out stale files.
  • Photos web: Archived albums no longer appear in the gallery’s horizontal bar, keeping that space focused on active albums. Memory links now include branding.
  • Auth: Desktop settings and dialogs received a more native layout, with centered dialogs and improved navigation. Settings styling and transitions were also refined, and Windows tray tooltips now display correctly.
  • Space and security: Encrypted, revocable profile-sharing links landed with profile previews and onboarding polish. 2-of-3 card handling was hardened against a reported security advisory.

In progress

  • Upcoming desktop ML: Rust ONNX Runtime integration would unify desktop ML indexing and CLIP embeddings, with native addons and guarded WebGPU acceleration.
  • Photos mobile: Unsupported Android media-permission handling would show a deletion prompt; trash database entries would gain file sizes; and the Memories banner would become fully tappable.
  • Own-collect replay reconciliation would preserve collection identity and added timestamps. In-app purchase updates target Google Play Billing 8 while retaining StoreKit 1 compatibility on iOS.

item.title: Ente digest Jul 28, 2026 - 32 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Ente shipped a broad set of Photos UI refinements alongside reliability fixes for authentication, sharing, and media handling. Work in progress includes more resilient photo imports, Android trash integration, and encrypted Space profile-sharing links.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos mobile: Refreshed the Trash empty state, gallery layout picker, referral screens, and People, Albums, and Memories widget settings with newer shared UI components: #11727, #11716, #11712, #11715. A new “crafting memories” banner is also live in Photos: #11359.
  • Photos sharing and organization: Album sorting is now centralized across shared, hidden, widget, ritual, and album views; comments retain the correct collection context; contacts refresh after participant changes; and verification now consistently uses the refreshed Verification ID sheet: #11713, #11706, #11695, #11676.
  • Photos reliability: Temporary video thumbnails are cleaned up after use, and shared-memory metadata is capped before parsing or decompression to limit excessive memory use: #11711, #11703.
  • Ente Auth: Rare mobile SRP signup, password-update, and recovery failures are fixed; malformed imported OTP entries are now reported instead of silently saved; and the Windows tray icon has a clean tooltip: #11723, #11705, #11683. Crypto derivation errors now correctly trigger the lower-memory recovery flow: #11561.
  • Space and Ensu: Space starts faster with cached identity and feed data, while Ensu’s Fedora Plasma package now includes standard icon sizes: #11678, #11679.
  • Other shipped maintenance includes the ONNX Runtime packaging update, public-link JWT handling, safer mailto parameters, and web dependency updates: #11704, #11698, #11531, #11722, #11724.

In progress

  • Photos imports: Invalid asset timestamps will fall back to filename, modification, or upload dates instead of aborting imports: #11721.
  • Space: Encrypted, revocable profile-sharing links—with public previews, rotation, and onboarding polish—are in progress: #11714.
  • Android system-trash entries may soon appear on the Photos Trash page: #11707. Documentation for shared Memory controls is also being added: #11709.
  • Scheduled workflows are being adjusted to avoid running on forks: #11697.

item.title: Ente digest Jul 27, 2026 - 17 shipped, 5 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work improves everyday Photos and Auth flows, with clearer verification and safer sharing/import handling. The next wave focuses on Android trash recovery, comment navigation, and a mobile ONNX Runtime packaging update.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos: The refreshed Verification ID sheet now appears consistently when verifying album participants and trusted-contact email addresses, replacing the older alert dialog (#11676).
  • Album participant changes now refresh Contacts efficiently, including batched refreshes for multi-person shares (#11695).
  • Photos’ “Crafting memories” banner is now available in the mobile app (#11359).
  • Ente Auth: Imported OTP entries are validated before saving, and malformed backup items are surfaced so they can be identified (#11705).
  • Space: Feed startup and refreshes are faster through cached identity and feed data, concurrent loading, asset caching, and animated new posts (#11678).
  • Security and reliability: Memory-share metadata decompression is capped at 1 MiB, limiting oversized payloads before parsing (#11703). Public-link JWT key errors are also handled correctly on the server (#11698).
  • Mobile support emails now encode subject and body parameters safely, preventing injected email fields (#11531).

Other merged changes covered shared lockscreen theming, web Photos UI fixes, dependency updates, workspace maintenance, CI metadata, and contribution documentation.

In progress

  • Photos for Android: A proposed update would show system-trash entries on the Photos trash page (#11707) and restore remote and local trash files together (#11693).
  • Latest-comment taps are being fixed to open the correct album, while preserving draft restoration behavior and adding focused tests (#11706).
  • Mobile Photos and Ensu are being moved to the ONNX Runtime r3 packaging release, with unified iOS and Android packaging and build triggers (#11704).
  • Scheduled workflows are being prevented from running on forks, reducing unwanted failed jobs and notifications (#11697).

item.title: Ente digest Jul 26, 2026 - 1 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
Ente Photos shipped a refreshed verification flow, while upcoming work spans photo editing, Auth account management, Space performance, and desktop polish. Several of these changes are focused on making everyday interactions faster and clearer across platforms.

Shipped

  • Ente Photos (mobile): Refreshed the Verification ID sheet to match Locker’s styling while preserving the existing copy, email, and sharing behavior.

In progress

  • Ente Photos (web): Adding a Straighten control to the photo editor. Users will be able to level tilted horizons with a -45° to +45° slider, live alignment preview, and automatic cropping to remove empty corners.
  • Ente Auth (mobile): Adding multi-account support and profile switching, allowing up to five online or offline vaults to remain signed in and be switched from Settings.
  • Ente Photos (mobile): Extending the refreshed Verification ID sheet to album-participant and trusted-contact email verification, replacing the legacy alert dialog.
  • Ente Space: Improving feed loading and caching with cached startup data, concurrent fetching, animated new posts, asset caching, and related cleanup and copy updates.
  • Ente Auth (desktop): Fixing the system-tray tooltip so hovering the icon shows “ente Auth” instead of an operating-system default label.
  • Desktop packaging: Adding standard icon sizes for Fedora Plasma, addressing missing icon registration in the RPM package.
  • Server: Keeping collection-trash processing scoped to batches so deletion work remains bounded and retry progress stays aligned.

item.title: Ente digest Jul 25, 2026 - 18 shipped, 7 in progress
item.description:
A busy day across Ente’s apps, with improvements to Photos sharing, casting, uploads, and web usability. Ensu also gained a full English Wikipedia knowledge pack, while several mobile UI and backend maintenance changes landed.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: reliable Chromecast sending adds native receiver discovery, pairing, authentication, and local stop controls on Android and iOS; memory link shares now include titles.
  • Photos web: upload progress v2 improves visibility during uploads, while person assignment gains a search bar. Collection and upload flow refinements also shipped in CollectionSelector/dialog updates and upload UX fixes.
  • Photos mobile UI: the Verification ID sheet and device cache settings were refreshed, and direct People navigation filters were fixed.
  • Ensu: Ensu Packs are enabled on Android and iOS, with the English Wikipedia fullwiki pack, updated relevance thresholds, and a simpler download UI. Model, transcription, and knowledge-pack downloads now share one asset store.
  • Ente Space: social and feed improvements include dark-friendly legal links, post caption editing, friend-request management, messaging or unfriending, smoother loading, and invite prompts.
  • Locker and shared mobile UI: account wording and signup were simplified; security hardening and dead contact-picker removal also landed.
  • Maintenance: Rust authentication was moved into the accounts crate in #11662, imports were cleaned up in #11667, and documentation gained FAQ entries in #11635.

In progress

  • Server: batch-scoped collection-trash processing aims to keep deletion batches bounded and retry progress aligned; request-context propagation through AddFiles will allow canceled requests to stop database work.
  • Photos: clear device album caches on logout, a CollectionSelector style fix, and reading Legacy Kit shares from PDF text are underway.
  • Other: dark mode for ente.space and migration of the shared lockscreen to ente_components are in progress.

item.title: Ente digest Jul 24, 2026 - 24 shipped, 2 in progress
item.description:
Today’s changes span Photos, Space, Auth, and Ensu, with several user-facing improvements alongside infrastructure and privacy hardening. A major highlight is faster on-device ML indexing, while Ensu gains opt-in knowledge packs.

Shipped

  • Photos and Space: Space now supports viewing friends’ cover photos, editing captions, managing friend requests, messaging or unfriending friends, smoother feed and avatar loading, and better action menus in PR #11648. Photos also gets a smoother web upload experience in PR #11649, a dismissible download-error toast in PR #11628, and favourite indicators for incoming shared photos in PR #11629.
  • Photos performance: Major mobile ML indexing optimizations reduce copying and processing overhead, improve model portability, and cautiously roll out Android WebGPU support in PR #11571.
  • Public sharing: Photos public album links now use the shorter albums.ente.com/TOKEN#KEY format, with matching mobile fallback and documentation updates in PR #11134.
  • Ensu: Ensu now has opt-in, on-device knowledge packs with download, update, cancellation, enablement, retrieval, and source-citation support across Android and iOS in PR #11617.
  • Auth and Locker: Auth adds more icons and aliases in PR #11546, while Locker removes the default text-input limit in PR #11537. Mobile settings also adds a “More from Ente” section with platform-aware app links in PR #11642.
  • Security and reliability: Share-password tokens now have shorter lifetimes in PR #11645, and account-recovery handling is safer against cleanup races in PR #11613. Documentation also gains new Auth, Photos, and Locker FAQs in PR #11635.

In progress

  • Photos web: A new search bar for the Assign Person dialog will make it easier to find people without scrolling through the full list in PR #11650.
  • Photos web: CollectionSelector and SingleInputDialog are being updated to their v2 versions in PR #11651.

item.title: Ente digest Jul 23, 2026 - 19 shipped, 4 in progress
item.description:
Today’s shipped work focuses on faster and more capable on-device processing in Photos and new on-device knowledge packs in Ensu. There are also several usability fixes across web and mobile, plus self-hosting and account-recovery improvements.

Shipped

  • Photos mobile: Major ML indexing optimizations reduce processing overhead and improve portability across iOS CoreML and Android WebGPU/XNNPACK. Unassigned face clusters can now be linked to contacts, and face clusters are sorted by photo count to make that picker easier to use.
  • Ensu: Opt-in on-device knowledge packs add downloadable, searchable packs with local retrieval, source citations, and controls to download, update, cancel, and enable them.
  • Photos mobile: Contact-first avatars now prefer saved contact names and photos across search, sharing, and family views. Incoming shared photos in Memories now show the favourite icon, and family member names appear on the storage-limit page.
  • Photos web: Chromecast receiver compatibility was fixed, while download toasts can now be dismissed when retries do not help.
  • Platform and self-hosting: Account recovery no longer races account cleanup; self-hosted API path prefixes are preserved; and the recent server CORS changes were reverted to simplify self-hosting.
  • Smaller shipped fixes include long user-agent handling in logout confirmation and access-token use for mobile family requests.

In progress

  • Server: Find scheduled deletions by email, retaining a keyed email hash for admin lookup and recovery verification.
  • Documentation: Add FAQ entries across the Auth, Photos, and Locker docs.
  • Ensu: Remove the parking_lot dependency.
  • Auth: Add DonanımHaber icon data to the custom icon set.
